presentation.label: Abdominal pain
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us more about your abdominal pain: when it started, what other symptoms you have such as diarrhoea or bleeding, any clear triggers.

questions.question: Has the pain been severe at any point?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the abdominal pain has been severe?

questions.question: Have you had nausea or vomiting?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had nausea or vomiting?

questions.question: Have you noticed any change in your bowel habits, such as diarrhoea or constipation?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has noticed a change in their bowel habits?

questions.question: Have you noticed any blood in your stool?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has noticed blood in their stool?

questions.question: Have you had a fever?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had a fever?

questions.question: Have you had any urinary symptoms such as pain when urinating or needing to urinate more frequently than usual?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has urinary symptoms such as pain when urinating or increased urinary frequency?

questions.question: Have you had any surgery to your abdomen in the last three months?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had abdominal surgery recently?

abdominal_pain_urgent.message: Severe abdominal pain, fever, or a history of recent abdominal surgery requires prompt medical assessment. Please call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.
